concept.title: Creature shuffle
concept.notation: X is a finite set; |X| = n ∈ {0, 1, 2, …}; Sym(X) is the set of permutations of X; 0! = 1.
concept.hypotheses: A permutation of X is a bijection σ: X → X.
concept.statement: For every finite set X with n elements, |Sym(X)| = n!. Each permutation maps every element to exactly one element and every element has exactly one preimage.
concept.visual_mapping: Numbered creatures identify the elements of X; their positions represent a bijection to the original ordered positions. A slider enumerates each arrangement exactly once.
concept.limitations: The renderer allows 2 ≤ n ≤ 6; the statement is general for finite sets. It is a representation using a chosen ordering, not a claim that every set is naturally ordered.
concept.source_quote: This is a synthetic demonstration, not an extraction from Gyile’s coursework.
